model_output.rationale: Line 2 billed 97140 x 7 units but chart documents only 30 minutes of manual therapy, which is 2 units per the 8-minute rule. CO-151 + N362 = MUE exceeded. This is a keying error — units on the claim don't match documentation. Medicare Part B, adjudicated claim: correct via clerical-error reopening.

root_cause.explanation: 97140 billed at 7 units; chart note documents 30 minutes = 2 units. Units exceed MUE because they were miscoded, not because the service was over-delivered.

next_action.detail: Request clerical-error reopening with MAC (Part B does not accept frequency 7). Correct 97140 units from 7 to 2. Reference ICN 2609585102539.
